title: Ecology SpeciesAreaIsland

stats.done_summary: Completed species-area relationship analysis for island biogeography. Analyzed 25 islands, fitted power law model (S = 14.305 × A^0.220), found significant positive relationship (R² = 0.22, p = 0.017). Generated 5 figures and comprehensive report with conservation planning implications including reserve sizing recommendations and extinction risk heuristics.
